subject: Truthful release identity, contributor-safe defaults, and owned dependency risk.

dimensions.desc: Requires one exact report across native CLI, Component contract, npm manifests, and staged carriers while ignoring only untracked runtime state, not tracked .pi source.
Moves current URLs to pzzld-org, preserves historical/contributor attribution, and removes bypass, unrestricted shell, prompt suppression, and personal automation from shared Claude settings.
Classifies measured findings by closure, reachability, affected/fixed versions, paths, and shipped artifacts; derives npm production closure from the lock and gates reachable high/critical findings.
Requires owner/reason/tracking/future expiry for waivers, Dependabot coverage for npm/Cargo/Actions, SECURITY.md, measured-only upgrades, and honest cargo-deny availability.

guidance: Reward tracked authority, a concrete compatibility report, current-vs-historical identity distinction, minimal shared settings, lock-derived reachability, explicit finding ownership, expiring waivers, and synthetic failure controls. Penalize directory-wide source exclusions, raw audit-count suppression, speculative upgrades, permanent waivers, unsafe shared permissions, missing disclosure process, or fabricated tool evidence.
